title: Saving dead languages
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
When a language disappears, what is lost besides words?
Should governments spend money to preserve a language spoken by only a small number of people?
Can a language survive if children understand it but rarely speak it?
Is teaching an endangered language at school enough to bring it back into daily life?
What would motivate younger people to use a language associated mainly with older generations?
